data-pipeline-governance.md.purpose: Schema, delivery, data-quality and resumable partition/backfill governance.
data-pipeline-governance.md.decision: adapt partition evidence and monotonic sink contracts; reject MERGE implies commutativity/exactly-once.
data-pipeline-governance.md.analysis: Read entire source. Initial schema decision says optional additive producer-first; later default BACKWARD requires consumer-first, so deployment order must derive actual schema-mode/version compatibility and replay horizon. MERGE merely upserts: old backfill can overwrite newer streamed state unless revision/event-time comparison and atomic predicate enforce monotonicity. Dedup windows do not cover arbitrary late replay and exactly-once effect requires all side effects, not only sink PK. max(updated_at) freshness can pass while most partitions stale; row counts can hide offsetting loss/duplicates. Fixed watermark24h does not universally imply only24h emissions (triggers/late-data policy matter). Ledger row+lock useful but needs lease/generation and same-sink commit authority; instructions don't implement it. messaging-governance requires this file and vice versa; generic matcher doesn't recursively enforce prerequisites, so not runtime cycle protection. Existing Zeus flush_outbox and schema source trace provides concrete overlap, not ETL engine implementation. No source tests/registry/DLQ commands run.
data-pipeline-governance.md.platform: Claude Bash/Read/Grep and external Airflow/Flink/dbt/metastore tools not part of inner Zeus dependencies. Windows-native SQL/CLI encoding remains untested. Zeus PostgreSQL runtime ledger and fenced generation checkpoints suit reprocessing; Git source schemas and immutable references replace ad hoc README authority. External engine defaults and linked versions unverified.

messaging-governance.md.purpose: Consumer commit/ack, event identity, retry/DLQ and per-key ordering contracts.
messaging-governance.md.decision: adapt at-least-once plus durable idempotency; reject outbox alone establishes consumer dedup/order.
messaging-governance.md.analysis: All body read. Outbox makes local state+intent atomic, publisher crash between publish and sent/delete redelivers; consumer dedup must be transactional with effects. Source conflates dedup and outbox, and suggests retry-topic bypass while retaining per-key ordering without sequencing/barrier repair. Timestamp last-write-wins needs clock/tie policy and can't replace state-machine order. Kafka partition/concurrency and10s session assumptions do not cover listed SQS/NATS/RabbitMQ systems; receive without ack can change visibility/lease, not necessarily read-only. DLQ0 is not evidence retry too permissive. Zeus adapters/bus.py fully read: validate then XADD; XAUTOCLAIM before XREADGROUP; dead_letter XADD then ACK can duplicate DLQ at crash; Lua compact atomically protects pending/undelivered boundaries with decimal string IDs (avoids2^53). service.flush_outbox publishes before sent in store tx explicitly admits redelivery; CLI81-116 handles+flushes before ACK and routes ContractError/JSONDecodeError/KeyError to DLQ. test_bus.py only invalid retain avoids Redis; integration1-230 includes pending/multiple-group/large-ID retention and DB-commit-beforeACK recovery, not executed here (requires isolated PostgreSQL+Redis; active bootstrap prohibited).
messaging-governance.md.platform: Advisory Claude/broker CLI syntax translated per OS. Zeus Redis adapter imports third-party redis only at outer boundary, JSON schema adapter uses jsonschema, six-W resource pins allowed shape; PostgreSQL remains runtime authority. Specific Redis external dependencies/config/store internals and whole integration file not fully reviewed here; no production or exact-once claim.

search-governance.md.purpose: Search relevance fixtures, rewrite/ranking, index freshness and zero-result recovery.
search-governance.md.decision: adapt golden-query regressions; exclude automatic ACL/filter weakening and uncontrolled query logs.
search-governance.md.analysis: All source sections read. Broadening filters (market/category) must never weaken tenant/authorization/consent restrictions; popular fallback must preserve permissions and explicit no-match status. Zero-result raw queries can contain secrets/PII and require bounded retention/redaction. Numeric30-100queries/<5%zero/boost1-3/30s refresh are hypotheses requiring domain distribution. Multiplicative ranking can zero all relevance when a signal zero; popularity feedback requires debiasing. Multiword search-time synonym weakness claim needs engine-version evidence; synonym graph capabilities not verified. Existing index reindex does not generically lock it for hours; alias atomic switch alone doesn't close concurrent-write/catch-up gap. force_merge is mutation and can be expensive, not automatic repair. 768float32=3072bytes/vector excludes graph/metadata overhead. Generic source matcher score/routing is not Elasticsearch retrieval or ranking engine; no dedicated scripts/agents reference found. No _analyze/reindex/merge/API evaluation executed.
search-governance.md.platform: Claude curl/Bash hooks require shell/Windows quoting; no Elasticsearch/H3/cloud installation authorized. Zeus routing has lexical candidate matching and immutable skill admission, not business-search equivalence; golden cases could test false positive/negative retrieval while keeping access filtering at authoritative boundary. Remote technical assertions remain unverified.

db-change-review.md.purpose: Migration planning, plan/lock deltas, resumable DML and restore evidence.
db-change-review.md.decision: adapt phased migration and evidence; reject row-count safety thresholds, host ANALYZE execution and destructive repair recipes.
db-change-review.md.analysis: Complete body read. <100Krows directALTER and selectivity-first composite indexes aren't universally safe; actual lock mode/version/workload/order/equality prefixes govern. Decision prohibits10K+ batch, Gotcha recommends10K-100K chunks, contradictory numeric advice. EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes SQL and can mutate/lock on DML/functions; unlike EXPLAIN not read-only. pg_repack is not arbitrary onlineALTER replacement; fixed2x disk/single-thread replica assertions need version-specific verification. Idempotence doesn't require WHERE becomes0 (setting same value can be idempotent), and PK cursor can miss concurrent lower-key mutations. timestamp-to-second filenames still collide and can invert order with clocks; latestorigin/develop+1 is TOCTOU unless serialized/CI unique. Applied-migration immutability valuable but existence/rename choices require every deployed history; 401login response isn't general backend health proof. Mysql/postgres type equivalences omit timezone/boolean semantics. Copying production data/backups demands redaction/isolated fixtures. No DDL, restore, EXPLAIN ANALYZE or SQL test run. Linked private WGS generator not read/proven.
db-change-review.md.platform: Bash process substitution/comm, mysql/psql and Flyway external; Windows PowerShell not interchangeable. Zeus PostgreSQL store/migrations are candidate mapping, not MySQL5.7 adoption; schema Git and runtime PostgreSQL retained. Backup/log artifacts must be encrypted/bounded with independent execution receipts; no template authorizes runtime modifications.

Decimal12,2 hardcode assumes money scale/range; child price int differs from BigDecimal advice. Index-allWHERE/ORDERBY and read90% denormalization need actual plans/costs. ERDSSOT thenDDLSSOT conflict needs reconciled contract authority, not blindly rewrite one. Existing schema changes via init only affect empty volumes; source twice advises docker volume rm, unacceptable for existing state and contradicts rollback-readiness. mermaid.live render may disclose schema externally; no upload. h3-geo-indexing.md.decision: defer optional geospatial capability; no current Zeus operational need or H3 dependency verified.
h3-geo-indexing.md.analysis: All body/source links read. Claimed Apache2/stable4.4.1/dates/edge lengths/~17%distortion/adoption list remain unverified original assertions. Resolution0-15 is16 levels but quality table says15. Child count7/6 valid only next resolution, signature omits required childRes in Gotcha. gridDisk includes origin; says5cells excluding self, which needs distinguishing API return count from neighbor count. Logical parent derived from fine index can differ geographically from direct coarse coordinate indexing; cannot universally ban recomputation unless contract is hierarchical containment. Average edge length is not uniform precision or buffer proof; oneedge polygon buffer may not guarantee complete intersection coverage. int64 vsuint64 and Javascript numeric serialization must preserve index bits; numeric locality isn't guaranteed distance order. Coarse8-9 can still identify location, not sufficient anonymization. Same res join necessary but not enough for geometric distance queries. quality_axes_enforced true ignored by generic matcher; no H3-specific script/agent/tests located or run.
